item.title: UDOT announces major projects on US-6 in Spanish Fork Canyon
item.description: The Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT) announced it is beginning two major projects on U.S. Highway 6 in Spanish Fork Canyon.

item.title: Tech industry trade group sues Utah over app store age verification law
item.description: A tech industry trade association filed a lawsuit on Thursday against the Utah Attorney General and Division of Consumer Protection, hoping to block a law from last year that would require app stores to do age verification before users can download apps.

item.title: AI data center could be coming to Provo's East Bay, fueling mixed reactions
item.description: A proposal to build a data center in the heart of Provo’s East Bay is sparking debate among residents and tech leaders over water use, power demands, and whether the project would truly benefit the community.

item.title: Five takeaways on the search for Savannah Guthrie's mother
item.description: Law enforcement provided new details on Thursday in the search for Nancy Guthrie, the 84-year-old mother of the “Today” show co-anchor Savannah Guthrie who went missing from her home this weekend in what officials believe to be an abduction.

item.title: Blood found at home was Nancy Guthrie's, no suspect identified: sheriff
item.description: Investigators have shared additional details about the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie.

item.title: Utah County residents react to 3.5 magnitude earthquake
item.description: A 3.5 magnitude earthquake Thursday afternoon was widely felt across Utah county, and some residents across Utah county told ABC4 about it.

item.title: Construction on controversial Heber Valley Temple allowed to continue after Utah Supreme Court ruling
item.description: The Utah Supreme Court ruled today to suspend an injunction that prevented the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints from constructing a temple in Heber Valley.

item.title: BYU students, professor among protestors demonstrating against border patrol presence on campus
item.description: Dozens of protestors participated in a demonstration near BYU's campus Thursday, during a job fair at the school which included recruiters from Customs and Border Patrol.

item.title: Utahns carry torch on route to Milano for Italy 2026, prepare for 2034
item.description: Multiple Utahns carried the torch this week as it made its way to Milano for the Winter Games, including members of several influential philanthropic Utah families.

item.title: Bills affecting transgender healthcare pass Utah House
item.description: Two bills affecting transgender healthcare that have been criticized for singling out transgender Utahns passed the house on Thursday. One bill bans transgender hormonal care for minors, and the other prevents public funds from being used for transgender health care.
